sources.title: Seed-Evolving — official model documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened the full official Markdown on October 27, 2026. Exact doubao-seed-evolving rolling endpoint; stated revision September 9, 2026. Lists 1024k context, text/image/video understanding, text generation, deep thinking, and function calling, but no nominal total or activated parameter count or publicly sized base model. API configuration parameters are not model sizes.

sources.title: Model release announcements — 2026
sources.evidence: Reopened the full release Markdown on October 27, 2026. The June section initially releases Evolving; July adds 1M context, and later entries update the same rolling ID. September separately lists Seed2.1 Pro 260915 and an Evolving update without parameter counts. The 552B total and 8–16B activated figures in another September row belong to DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, not Evolving.

sources.title: Doubao model service agreement, effective September 23, 2026
sources.evidence: Applies to the Doubao model service. Sections 1.2 and 2 restrict the service license; sections 5.1–5.2 retain model ownership and state that algorithms, parameters, and source code are not provided.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full 73-page text extracted from the official PDF freshly fetched on October 27, 2026, including model descriptions and comparison tables. Describes Seed2.1 Pro and Turbo but supplies no nominal total/active size assignable to Seed-Evolving, no publicly sized Evolving base, and no activated-parameter comparison column for it. Generic self-evolving development language is not an exact model identification.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity (June 30, 2026)
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full 87-page text extracted from the June 30 first-party card freshly fetched on October 27, 2026, including comparisons. Describes Seed2.0 Pro, Lite and Mini; no exact Evolving entry or nominal total/activated count that can be assigned to it. No explicit publicly sized base relationship established.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Officially Released: Advancing AI Productivity
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The June 23 announcement describes Seed2.1 productivity and benchmark improvements, with no Evolving entry or nominal total/active count. It still does not substantiate an exact June 23 release day for Evolving.

sources.title: ByteDance Seed publications
sources.evidence: Reopened the current first-page publication index on October 27, 2026, through the October 25 Recycler entry. Fresh English/Chinese exact-model, nominal size, active/activated-parameter and named-base searches did not locate an additional supported Evolving disclosure. This is a bounded search, not proof that no future disclosure exists.

sources.title: Volcano Engine model list
sources.evidence: Fetched full official Markdown October 27, 2026. Lists doubao-seed-evolving and doubao-seed-2-1-pro-260915 separately in capability, context, limit and API tables. Neither row reports total or active parameters. The current document does not explicitly identify their exact revision mapping or a publicly sized Evolving base.

sources.title: Seed2.1 overview and evaluation results
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. Calls Pro and Turbo different sizes but supplies no numeric size; evaluation tables report benchmark scores, not an activated-parameter column. No Evolving-specific specification.

sources.title: 360 SmartBrain Seed Evolving provider listing
sources.evidence: Followed the same-as-Pro lead and opened this third-party serving-provider page October 27, 2026. It describes the current version as the same as doubao-seed-2.1-pro, without a 260915 revision or any numeric total/active size. This corroborates a routing relationship as a lead, not a ByteDance parameter disclosure. The linked Pro console page yielded only an app shell; current official Markdown and the full Pro card still supply no nominal count from which to infer Evolving size.

name.note: Official name Seed-Evolving; baseline spacing is a normalized display name.

developer.note: The exact-model release entry names ByteDance as provider.

family.note: Official description places the model in the Seed series.

release_date.note: Initial release is explicitly listed under June 2026; June 23 is supported for Seed2.1, not this exact rolling model. Retain month precision.

open_weights.note: Hosted Doubao service; section 5.2 expressly says model parameters and source code are not provided.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the restricted commercial service license; no open-weight grant.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 English/Chinese exact-model and named-base searches, reopened official endpoint/release/model-list docs, and full later Seed2.1/Seed2.0 cards found no published nominal total. A provider identifies Evolving with Seed2.1 Pro, but neither that page nor the first-party Pro card gives a numeric size; exact Pro260915 mapping was not confirmed by the retrieved developer text. No publicly sized base supports an inference. Null reflects missing published nominal evidence, not a requirement for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Checked activated/per-token counts separately in fresh searches, current developer documentation and later first-party comparison tables. No Evolving-specific nominal active count or activated-parameter column was found. The release table's 8–16B entry is DeepSeek V4.1 Flash and cannot be transferred to Evolving. No total-equals-active assumption is made.

architecture.note: No exact-model architecture found in official docs, first-party cards, or targeted training/interpretability searches; Transformer, dense and MoE remain unasserted.

context_window.note: Current rolling endpoint documentation says 1024k tokens, normalized with decimal k; July 2026 announcement records the 1M upgrade from the older specification.

modalities.note: Explicit text/image/video understanding and text generation; audio input is explicitly unsupported.

reasoning.note: Deep thinking is supported and enabled by default.

tool_call.note: Function calling is supported with dedicated tool-call usage guidance.

description.value: Continuously updated Seed model for reasoning, coding, task planning, tool calling, and image and video understanding.
description.note: Plain summary of supported capabilities and the rolling update mechanism.

patch.description: Continuously updated Seed model for reasoning, coding, task planning, tool calling, and image and video understanding.
patch.notes: Rolling doubao-seed-evolving endpoint: specifications reflect the official card accessed October 27, 2026, whose stated model revision is September 9, 2026. Initial release is documented only to June 2026; the July entry is a context upgrade. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed; no publicly sized base supports an inference. Architecture remains undisclosed.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit: retain null total and active counts after reopening official endpoint/release/model-list documentation, independently checking freshly fetched full Seed2.1 and June Seed2.0 cards and later comparison tables, and fresh English/Chinese exact-model and named-base searches. Followed the same-as-Pro provider lead; neither it nor the first-party Pro material supplies a nominal size. Add explicit null parameter patches and preserve all unrelated field assessments and existing corrections.
